mutants.why: A permanent email error is no longer recorded as a permanent failure: it falls through to the retry path, and a transient error is failed instead of retried.
A permanent push error is treated like a transient one: the job returns an error and River retries it instead of marking the delivery permanently failed.

mutants.old:
WHERE account_id = $1 AND app = $2
ORDER BY token
mutants.new:
WHERE account_id = $1 AND $2::text <> ''
ORDER BY token
mutants.why: The device token lookup no longer filters by App, so a BUYER-audience push also reaches the account's seller App token (and vice versa).
